text:
I can install the binary now, but setup needs root, and I can't type a sudo password. Before I start, I need a few answers from you.

## Ask first

1. **Is `me/notes` public?** Codeberg repos are public by default. Tentmaker refuses public repos unless you pass `--allow-public`, which lets outside contributors' code run on this Mac. I'll only add that flag with your explicit yes.
2. **Can this Mac hold a Codeberg token?** Giving it one makes this Mac a broker that reads your repo and posts commit statuses. Other devices in the pool never see the token.
3. **Create the token yourself.** In Codeberg, open Settings → Applications and create an access token with repository read and write permissions. Keep it in your clipboard for step 3 below. Don't paste it into this chat.
4. **Is this Mac on Tailscale?** If not, I'll add `--no-mesh` so it runs as a single device.

## Step 1: install the binary (I'll run this once you say yes)

Without root, the installer puts the binary in `~/.local/bin`, so no sudo is needed:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup
tentmaker version --json
```

If the installer says `~/.local/bin` isn't on PATH, I'll call the binary by its full path.

## Step 2: check status (no root needed)

```sh
tentmaker status --json
```

## Step 3: setup needs root, so you run this in your own terminal

Codeberg is Forgejo, so it uses the forgejo connector with checks mode. Checks mode needs no workflow changes and no forge runner. Tentmaker reads `.forgejo/workflows` or `.github/workflows` at each commit and posts statuses named `tentmaker/<job>`.

```sh
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json \
  --forge forgejo --forge-url https://codeberg.org --mode checks \
  --repo me/notes --token-stdin --no-mesh
```

It will read the token from stdin. Paste it, press Enter, then Ctrl-D. Add `--allow-public` only if you said yes to question 1. Drop `--no-mesh` if the Mac is on Tailscale. Leave out `--memory` and `--boost-memory` to take the defaults: a quarter of RAM and half of RAM when plugged in.

Setup's JSON output lists each step. Send me the `steps` section if anything fails, and I'll apply the `fix` it gives.

## Step 4: verify (I'll run these after step 3)

```sh
tentmaker doctor --json
tentmaker repo list --json
tentmaker budget --json
```

Once `doctor` exits 0, push a commit to `me/notes`. You should see a `tentmaker/<job>` status on the commit within a few minutes. To make a status block merges, add it as a required check in Codeberg's branch protection.

## Limits to know about

- Checks mode runs `run` steps and the common setup actions. It skips jobs that use `services`, `container`, a job-level `if`, or a matrix with more than one combination. Skipped jobs post no status.
- Forks never run. Pull requests from outside are only run if the author is on the list (you, by default).
